description: A shrimp roll recipe written in a phone message with emoji standing in for many words (🦐 shrimp, 🏆 cup, 🍋 lemon, 🐎radish horseradish, 🍇👀d oil grapeseed oil, ✂️ chopped/cut, 👶 small, ✡️ kosher). 11 ingredients; 375°F oven. A good draft decodes the clear emoji into plain words, leaves no emoji in the recipe, and flags the ones that are genuinely unclear (like the kind of rolls).
